source_text: Δευτέρα δὲ ἐντολὴ τῆς διδαχῆς: οὐ φονεύσεις, οὐ μοιχεύσεις, οὐ παιδοφθορήσεις, οὐ πορνεύσεις, οὐ κλέψεις, οὐ μαγεύσεις, οὐ φαρμακεύσεις, οὐ φονεύσεις τέκνον ἐν φθορᾷ, οὐδὲ γεννηθὲν ἀποκτενεῖς, οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις τὰ τοῦ πλησίον. οὐκ ἐπιορκήσεις, οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις, οὐ κακολογήσεις, οὐ μνησικακήσεις. οὐκ ἔσῃ διγνώμων οὐδὲ δίγλωσσος: παγὶς γὰρ θανάτου ἡ διγλωσσία. οὐκ ἔσται ὁ λόγος σου ψευδής, οὐ κενός, ἀλλὰ μεμεστωμένος πράξει, οὐκ ἔσῃ πλεονέκτης οὐδὲ ἅρπαξ οὐδὲ ὑποκριτὴς οὐδὲ κακοήθης οὐδὲ ὑπερήφανος. οὐ λήψῃ βουλὴν πονηρὰν κατὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου. οὐ μισήσεις πάντα ἄνθρωπον, ἀλλὰ οὓς μὲν ἐλέγξεις, περὶ δὲ ὦν προσεύξῃ, οὓς δὲ ἀγαπήσεις ὑπὲρ τὴν ψυχήν σου.
pass_a_gloss: Second the commandment of the teaching: you will not kill, you will not commit adultery, you will not corrupt children, you will not fornicate, you will not steal, you will not practice magic, you will not use potions, you will not kill a child by abortion, nor will you kill a newborn, you will not covet the things of your neighbor. You will not swear falsely, you will not bear false witness, you will not speak evil, you will not hold grudges. You will not be double-minded nor double-tongued: for double-tonguedness is a snare of death. Your word will not be false, nor empty, but filled with action, you will not be greedy nor a robber nor a hypocrite nor evil nor arrogant. You will not take evil counsel against your neighbor. You will not hate every person, but those you will rebuke, about whom you will pray, those you will love more than your own soul.
pass_b_english: The second commandment of the teaching is this: Do not kill, do not commit adultery, do not corrupt children, do not fornicate, do not steal, do not practice magic, do not use potions, do not kill a child by abortion, and do not kill a newborn. Do not covet what belongs to your neighbor. Do not swear falsely, do not bear false witness, do not speak evil of anyone, and do not hold grudges. Do not be double‑minded or double‑tongued, because a double tongue is a snare of death. Let your word not be false or empty, but filled with action. Do not be greedy, a robber, a hypocrite, evil, or arrogant. Do not plot evil against your neighbor. Do not hate every person; instead, rebuke some, pray for others, and love some more than your own life.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text of Didache 2. Pass A and Pass B maintain the meaning, agency, and distinctions of the original commandments. The title 'Teachings of the Lord' is a suitable thematic title for the work.
